source_caption:
Avengement (2019) follows Cain Burgess, a hardened criminal who escapes from prison and returns to the criminal underworld determined to settle old scores. After years of brutal treatment behind bars, Cain is driven by anger and betrayal, with the people who ruined his life firmly in his sights.
Cain tracks down the individuals responsible for his downfall, forcing them to face the consequences of what they did to him. Along the way, the story reveals the painful events that transformed Cain from a man trying to survive into someone consumed by revenge.
As the night unfolds, Cain's mission becomes increasingly violent. Every confrontation exposes another piece of his past, showing how betrayal, crime, and years of suffering shaped the man he has become.
The film explores themes of revenge, loyalty, betrayal, survival, guilt, and redemption. Cain's journey raises the question of whether revenge can truly give someone back the life they lost—or whether it only creates more destruction.
What makes Avengement stand out is its intense hand-to-hand combat and personal story. The action feels connected to Cain's anger and desperation, making every confrontation part of his larger mission.
💬 After years of suffering, Cain came back with one thing on his mind—revenge.

source_details.synopsis: Avengement is a 2019 British action thriller film directed by Jesse V. Johnson who co-wrote the film with Stu Small. The film stars Scott Adkins, Craig Fairbrass and Thomas Turgoose. Avengement was released on 24 May 2019 on VOD and in selected theatres, where it received generally positive reviews from critics with praise for its action choreography and Adkins' performance. In 2020, a special edition was released, which contains an uncut version of the film.
